scientific.integrity: The Jacobian and modal characteristic polynomial were reconstructed directly from the published equations. A standalone verifier resolves the printed equilibrium, checks residuals and derivatives, and reproduces all stated numerical values.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects the linear Turing classification of the printed Figure 3 parameter set. It does not exclude finite-amplitude spatial structure or identify the implementation error that generated the published plot.

title: The published Figure 3 Turing instability disappears under the correct Jacobian
